intervention: xy_new = xy_prediction + alpha * (xy_official_reference - xy_prediction); all_half alpha=0.5; other corrected conditions alpha=1; local conditions replace both left and right joints in both existing views
observation_policy: Fixed finite baseline predicted coordinates and in-frame valid reference; no score threshold for the coordinate-only diagnostic. Retain low-confidence detections. No synthetic coordinates for absent detections.
primary: 2d method at 20000 steps, non-PA mean joint Euclidean distance
secondary: Fixed mixed method and extended 40000-step optimization; PA supplementary only
fixed_mixed_route: Use archived baseline accepted 3D targets and their covariances; otherwise use the same valid 2D views. Retriangulate only coordinates of already accepted 3D targets. Never change mask, covariance, group normalizer or shape subspace across interventions.
shape_policy: One baseline-geometry observable basis per pair, shared by both methods and all conditions; zero initial shape and template body pose
selection: Lowest feasible training objective at fixed checkpoints, no body-3D GT or output 3D error used

statistics.unit: one fixed pose from each of ten distinct sequences of subject S9
statistics.simultaneous_family: all eight interventions times all fifteen evaluation joints, within each method and budget
statistics.interpretation: Descriptive sequence-resampling sensitivity for a convenience sample, not cross-subject population inference

scope: Reconstruct same Adam trajectory from start, save at 20000 and continue to 40000; full 2D only
